title: Unicycive Reports Third-Quarter 2026 Financial Results
summary: Unicycive Therapeutics reported a Q3 2026 net loss of $7.0 million, or $0.25 per share, and about $59 million in cash as of September 30.
body_markdown:
Research and development expense was $2.2 million, compared with $3.0 million a year earlier, driven primarily, the company said, by a $1.2 million decrease in development costs, partially offset by a $0.5 million increase in non-cash stock-based compensation. General and administrative expense was $6.6 million, compared with $4.4 million, including a $1.4 million increase related to commercial launch preparation. Other income was $1.8 million, compared with $1.3 million, which the company attributed primarily to the change in fair value of its warrant liability.


The company said its cash position provides expected runway beyond 2027, including anticipated increased expenses related to the launch of oxylanthanum carbonate (OLC) should it receive approval.


## Why It Matters for UNCY


OLC is the company's investigational phosphate binder for patients with chronic kidney disease on dialysis. In October, Unicycive announced that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration accepted the resubmission of its New Drug Application for OLC and set a Prescription Drug User Fee Act (PDUFA) target action date of Thursday, March 25, 2027. According to the company, the resubmission followed a Complete Response Letter received in June 2026 that cited deficiencies at its original drug product vendor and did not raise concerns regarding clinical efficacy or safety data. The resubmitted application remains subject to FDA review.
